mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, chapter_id, source_type, source_text, rewrite_mode, instruction, status, segments_json, result_text, diff_payload, created_at, completed_at FROM story_rewrite_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id, chapter_id, source_type, source_text, rewrite_mode, instruction, status, segments_json, result_text, diff_payload, created_at, completed_at FROM story_rewrite_task ORDER BY COALESCE(completed_at, created_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_rewrite_task (project_id, chapter_id, source_type, source_text, rewrite_mode, instruction, status, segments_json, result_text, diff_payload, created_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceText}, #{rewriteMode}, #{instruction}, #{status}, #{segmentsJson}::jsonb, #{resultText}, #{diffPayload}::jsonb, NOW(), #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE story_rewrite_task SET status = #{status}, segments_json = #{segmentsJson}::jsonb, result_text = #{resultText}, diff_payload = #{diffPayload}::jsonb, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
